name: menu
description: Three straight menu bars with rounded ends.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner changed the Filled concept to Bold rather than a boxed cutout. Filled is fixed fill-only geometry matching the exact Outline centerlines rendered at Bold 2.25, with round cap radius 1.125. Outline retains default Regular 1.70 and radius-.85 caps. Both styles share centerlines and placement; weight is deliberately different. Centerlines are sized for exact 2px primary-pair margins at the Filled Bold reference. Regular Outline therefore has 2.275px on that same primary pair. No enclosing box or negative-space symbol is present. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. The owner approved both revised styles on 2026-10-27. Three straight equal centerlines x=3.125..20.875 at y=6,12,18. Filled visible bounds x=2..22/y=4.875..19.125; horizontal is the primary pair. Vertical margins preserve the natural bar spacing. Each bar is an analytical radius-1.125 capsule. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9859154930 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved the current unboxed Filled = Bold 2.25 treatment and corresponding Regular 1.70 Outline. Shared centerlines and native proportions are retained, with 2px Filled primary margins.
